verdicts.summary: Extraction / reasoning failure: Parenthesized negative number in financial table misattributed as positive profit.
verdicts.explanation: The source prospectus on page 28 formats net loss as '(4,157.43)' million following Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) conventions where parentheses denote negative values. A naive text parser strips parentheses and emits a positive net profit of ₹4,157.43 million, causing a false contradiction with subsequent reports showing historic losses.
verdicts.audit_notes: Handled by KnowledgeAuditor: detects parentheses in financial rows and enforces algebraic sign negation (-4,157.43).
